title: Lovely Bitter Kenyan Sweet Potatoes Fritters
description: A traditional Kenyan dish featuring bitter sweet potatoes, perfect for a brunch mood, made with caster sugar and deep-fried to perfection, and is egg-free friendly.
instructions: Peel and grate the sweet potatoes and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the grated sweet potatoes, caster sugar, all-purpose flour, cornstarch, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Gradually add the water to the mixture and mix until a thick batter forms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
